lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Emily Vazquez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Emily Vazquez is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Emily kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Emily's gone." Adaeze looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Emily." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Katarina blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Silver Tongue (Level 1). Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Emily Vazquez, 41 days. The mantle passes to Katarina Novak.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Katarina Novak, 28 — a journalist. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Translator, Fusion Reactor.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Emily — and Emily is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Dale, Greta, Adaeze speak for Katarina — "Emily trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Katarina before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d41: 📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU!"
d41: Plus 57 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
d41: ◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.
d41: Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
